_comment: Notes pinned to the wall and rendered on notes.html. Edit freely — this file is the only place the words live. `kind` picks the paper: note, index, sticky, receipt. Order here is the order they appear.

notes.title: welcome to the pretty corner of my mind
body: I draw people, mostly. Faces doing something with their whole face.
Multifandom, mainly One Piece, and a steady amount of characters nobody asked me to draw.
Everything on this wall was posted somewhere between April 2024 and now. You can pull any of it off the wall and throw it. Nothing breaks.

notes.title: commissions are open
body: Bust, half body, full body. Original characters welcome, fan characters welcome, your D&D guy especially welcome.
DM me on Instagram with what you want, references if you have them, and roughly when you need it.
I will tell you a price and a turnaround before either of us commits to anything.

notes.title: the slider
body: Drag the un-render slider and the whole wall walks itself backwards — finished, then flat colour, then lineart, then a rough underdrawing.
Be honest about this one: most of those stages are reconstructed by the site, not scans of my actual layers. The pieces marked 'actual wip' are the real thing.

notes.title: who is doing this
body: Medi. She/her. I have been drawing for a while and posting for less time than that.

The old version of this site was mostly jokes about One Piece and being bad at talking to people. (it wasnt me, it was the fault of someone shorter than me😭) That was accurate. This version has more drawings on it.
(ps. from said short person: it was accurate!)
